FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.

2. When practising Active listening 1.4 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Tone.

4. When practising Active Listening Attention Engagement Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)

5. When practising Interactive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Listening.

6. When practising Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary.

7. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. porte
   B. chaise
   C. fenêtre
   D. livre

8. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression Clarity Intonation Pacing.

10. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Good morning / hello
   B. Good night only
   C. Thank you
   D. Excuse me
